top news.title: SCOTUS limits the law enforcement use of “geofence” warrants, saying people have “a reasonable expectation of privacy” in their cell-phone location data

tweets.author: @scotus_wire
tweets.text: Justice Kagan delivered the opinion of the Court. Justice Gorsuch concurred in the judgment only. Justice Alito dissents, joined in part by Thomas and Barrett. Read the ruling here:

tweets.author: @aburkhartlaw
tweets.text: Big decision on geofence warrants out of the Supreme Court today.  SCOTUS rejects the third-party exception to the Fourth Amendment, which denies protection to records generated by or voluntarily exposed to a third-party, and finds that location data is indispensable to participation in modern society.  As a result, SCOTUS concludes that we have a reasonable expectation of privacy in our location data that is protected by the Fourth Amendment

tweets.author: @hissgoescobra
tweets.text: Thomas and Alito are just incredible at this point. Not a shred of independence or good faith left. Reading their dissents one cannot help but chuckle at the incredulousness of what they purport to believe. The Supreme Court must be reformed.

top news.title: SCOTUS finds that Trump's 2025 firing of FTC Commissioner Rebecca Kelly Slaughter without cause was lawful, placing independence of several agencies in doubt

tweets.author: @senmikelee
tweets.text: A good decision.  The President is the Chief Executive.  If Executive Branch employees do not answer to him, they do not answer to the American people.  Humphrey's Executor was wrongly decided in 1935.  Today, SCOTUS restores an important constitutional separation of powers.

tweets.author: @chrisvanhollen
tweets.text: Today, SCOTUS green-lit another expansion of Trump's power, letting him fire an FTC commissioner who dares disagree with him.  This decision threatens to let Trump stack agencies with cronies who'll serve his billionaire buddies at the expense of the people.  We must fight back.

tweets.author: @edwardtwinz
tweets.text: :rotating_light: Nobody is telling you what SCOTUS actually handed Trump today..the headlines say “Trump wins right to fire FTC commissioner”..that's the smallest version of this story..here's what actually happened...the FTC is just the first domino.. NLRB.. SEC.. EEOC.. every commission that wields executive power now sits under the same logic the court just applied..91 years of precedent.. gone in one opinion..

top news.title: South Korea, Samsung, and SK Hynix say they plan to invest ~$590B to build a new chip complex, including four chipmaking plants and a chip packaging cluster

tweets.author: @yoolimleenews
tweets.text: South Korea is orchestrating investments of at least $880 billion from companies including Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix into chips and data centers, a giant outlay in digital infrastructure it called essential to surviving the AI era.

tweets.author: @munster_gene
tweets.text: While $GOOG's entry into the Dow captured headlines, the real story is Samsung's and SK Hynix's capex buildout. The combined $590B in factory investments is about 48% higher than most had expected, underscoring yet again how early we are in the AI buildout.
